QZHW62100101.why: UM-01 Harbor Lights, her own recording (ISRC QZHW62100101, R-01, split sheet D-1): she wrote it alone and self-administers, so she registers 100 percent. Accrued 520.40 dollars, first usage January 2021, so it is among the usage the April 2027 distribution starts with.

QZHW62100102.why: UM-03 Paper Kites, her recording (QZHW62100102, D-2): she and Dov Lindqvist wrote it 50/50, both self-administered; she registers her 50 percent only. Accrued 244.80 dollars, her share 122.40

QZHW62200103.why: UM-05 Low Tide Radio (QZHW62200103, D-3): three writers, Nell 40, Dov 30 and Tobias 30, all self-administered; she registers 40 percent. Accrued 301.50 dollars, her share 120.60

QZHW62300104.why: UM-06 Kettle Hill (Acoustic) (QZHW62300104, D-4): the work Kettle Hill is hers alone, so 100 percent, matched by the recording's ISRC under the recording's title. Accrued 156.00 dollars

QZHW62200105.why: UM-07 Sparrow Season (QZHW62200105, D-5): she owns 60 percent, self-administered; Ines Valdor's 40 percent is administered by Hollin Court Music, which registers it. Accrued 218.00 dollars, her share 130.80

QZPR42400221.why: UM-08 Winter Orchard, recorded by Pelham Row (QZPR42400221, D-6): the band recorded her song with the writers' permission; she owns 70 percent, Tobias Renquist 30 percent, both self-administered. Accrued 412.50 dollars, her share 288.75

traps.QZAW72200314: UM-02 Harbor Lights by Ashbourne Weatherbirds: the same title as her song but a different composition; her Harbor Lights is the recording with ISRC QZHW62100101 (D-1). Matching by title would claim someone else's royalties
traps.QZFS32000877: UM-04 Paper Kites by Fenwick & Sloe: the same title as her song, a different composition and a different recording; her Paper Kites is QZHW62100102 (D-2)
traps.QZHW62300106: UM-09 Dust Roads: her own recording of a song T. Gannet and R. Oakes wrote (R-06 credits them); she has no writing share to register
traps.QZHW62200107: UM-10 Copper Bridge: Dov Lindqvist wrote it alone; Nell sang and produced the recording and has no share in the writing (D-8); registering it would claim a co-writer's money
traps.QZHW62300108: UM-11 Glasshouse: her 50 percent has been administered by Hollin Court Music since 1 July 2023 (D-7), and the publisher registers and collects it; she does not register it herself
traps.QZHW62100109: Ember Street (QZHW62100109): already registered on 11 March 2024 and matched (WK-1); it is not in the unmatched list and nothing is waiting
traps.QZHW61900110: Roadhouse Blue (QZHW61900110): a 2019 radio single never released digitally; the 178.40 dollars on her rights-desk statement (S-2) is a performance royalty paid through her performing rights organisation, and the collective holds nothing for it
traps.QZHW62500111: Tide Tables (QZHW62500111): streamed only in Germany and the United Kingdom (R-10); the blanket licence covers United States uses only, so nothing is held for it
